zh.title: 民航局離島第二波加班機11月24日將開放訂位 提供1,884席
zh.summary: 民航局第二波離島加班機11月24日將開訂，含放大機型共20架次、提供1,884席。
body: 交通部民用航空局表示，為因應地方公職人員選舉期間民眾返鄉投票需求，離島航線第二波加班機將於11月24日（星期二）上午9時起統一開放訂位，配合週末投票。
民航局本次再度協調航空公司，在運能許可下增開加班機，含放大機型共計20架次、提供1,884個座位。其中澎湖航線提供872個座位，金門航線提供872個座位，馬祖航線提供140個座位。
民航局提醒，選舉期間離島航線部分尖峯日期及時段機位需求較高；若未能訂到首選航班，旅客可考慮其他日期或離峯時段航班，以增加訂位機會。

en.title: Taiwan CAA to open second-wave island flight bookings Nov. 24, with 1,884 seats
en.summary: Taiwan CAA to open second-wave island flight bookings Nov. 24; 20 operations offer 1,884 seats.
body: Taiwan’s Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA) said bookings for a second wave of extra flights on outlying-island routes will open at 9 a.m. on November 24. The services are intended to meet demand from people travelling home to vote in local elections, with voting set for the weekend.

Following coordination with airlines within available capacity, the agency said the package covers 20 flight operations, including services using larger aircraft, providing 1,884 seats. The Penghu and Kinmen routes each account for 872 seats, while the Matsu routes account for 140.

The agency said demand is higher on some peak dates and at peak times during the election period. It advised travellers unable to book their preferred flight to consider other dates or off-peak services.
